n891365993b.headline: Škoda after explosion in Polička: 30 million. We will equip operations with automatic detectors, says director | Aktuálně.cz
n891365993b.summary: Following a recent explosion, Škoda's Polička plant plans to equip operations with automatic detectors, investing 30 million CZK to improve safety.
n891365993b.why: Industrial accidents and safety investments affect operational continuity and costs for manufacturing companies.
